sentences.1: Processing should be screened for factors indicating high-risk processing, such as processing data of vulnerable individuals.
sentences.10: You should also think carefully about doing a DPIA for any other processing that is large scale, involves profiling or monitoring, decides on access to services or opportunities, or involves sensitive data or vulnerable individuals.
sentences.11: Vulnerable individuals are those whose circumstances may restrict their ability to freely consent or object to data processing or understand its implications.
sentences.12: Individuals can be vulnerable where circumstances may restrict their ability to freely consent or object to the processing of their personal data, or to understand its implications.
sentences.13: Processing personal data of children or vulnerable individuals for marketing, profiling, automated decision-making, or offering online services requires a DPIA.
sentences.14: The use of the personal data of children or other vulnerable individuals for marketing purposes, profiling or other automated decision-making, or if you intend to offer online services directly to children.
sentences.15: A DPIA may also be carried out on a voluntary basis in order to identify and deal as effectively as possible with the risks, even if they are minor, to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.16: Where a data controller carries out a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA), which indicates that the intended processing would result in a high risk to the data protection rights of individuals in the absence of mitigating measures, the controller shall consult the Supervisory Authority.
sentences.17: The assets on which the personal data are based (hardware, software, networks, individuals, paper documents or paper transmission channels) are identified
sentences.18: Data controllers are required to carry out a DPIA before any processing that is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.19: Data controllers need to carry out a DPIA before any processing likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.2: Otherwise, you need to check whether your processing is on the list of types of processing that automatically require a DPIA.
sentences.3: If not, you need to screen for other factors that may indicate it is a type of processing that is likely to result in high risk, such as processing the data of vulnerable individuals.
sentences.4: Vulnerable individuals are those whose circumstances may restrict their ability to freely consent or object to processing or understand its implications.
sentences.5: Individuals can be vulnerable where circumstances may restrict their ability to freely consent or object to the processing of their personal data, or to understand its implications.
sentences.6: If processing involves invisible processing combined with any vulnerable individuals or other criteria, a DPIA must be conducted to help assess and mitigate impact on individuals' ability to exercise control over their data.
sentences.7: Your DPIA will help you assess and demonstrate whether you are taking a proportionate approach.
sentences.8: It will help you consider how best to mitigate the impact on individuals' ability to exercise control over their data, and whether you can take other measures to support the exercise of their rights.
sentences.9: Organizations should carefully consider conducting DPIAs for large-scale processing, profiling or monitoring, decisions on service access or opportunities, or processing of sensitive data or vulnerable individuals.
